decisions.reason: Accepting a stainless-steel whisk does not change the spout's removability or cleaning purpose.
The whisk material decision does not alter the existing spout-cleaning requirement.
The selected whisk material does not change bowl removal or swapping behavior.
The whisk selection does not change the requirement that bowl seals prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The candidate already has a message-64 MODIFY recording the accepted stainless-steel whisk design and material, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The source accepts a whisk and does not modify the independently selected stainless-steel spout design.
Whisk material selection does not change the required dispensing flow, pour sequence, or beverage-preservation criteria.
The source decision does not alter plumbing or bowl-seal leak-containment behavior.
The accepted whisk has no effect on the spout's barista-facing orientation.
The whisk material decision does not change solenoid actuation or button-controlled dispensing.
The requirement concerns delivery of component selection and a BOM; accepting one whisk option does not change that deliverable obligation or sourcing strategy.
Selecting a stainless-steel whisk is a design choice intended to meet the existing mixing-quality criteria, but it does not modify those criteria.
